text: The Clarke–Emerson–Sistla CTL model-checking algorithm runs in time:
choices: Exponential in the size of the model |M|
O(|M| · |φ|), polynomial in model and formula size
Constant time, independent of the model
explanation: CTL model checking is polynomial: O(|M| · |φ|) via the bottom-up labeling algorithm. This contrasts with LTL model checking, which is PSPACE-complete (choice 1) and exponential in formula size. The polynomial cost is what made CTL model checking practical.
